changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/11659-console-record-ux.md`

- names `HomePage.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **The backup-password reminder no longer appears in the user's first session.** 「建议设置一个备用密码」 showed on the environment home right after a new user built their first app: the reminder was gated on a home-visit count (quiet on the first home mount, shown on the second), and coming back to home after building is the second mount inside the first sitting. It now stays quiet for 12 hours after the first home visit on the device, so it first shows on a later day's visit. The first-visit record (`os:recovery-pw-first-seen`) now holds a timestamp; a device that holds the old `'1'` flag starts the 12 hours over rather than reading it as long ago. When storage is unavailable it stays quiet. `RecoveryPasswordReminder` moves out of `HomePage.tsx` into its own module; it is not exported from the package entry, and its other conditions (dismissed, SSO-enforced, has a local password) are unchanged.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `34354a4b6` (merge-base with origin/main): 29 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 684 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (707 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/39012707703)

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · objectui#12851 · head `034b96b` · 2026-10-17T07:14Z

Seat `domain:ui#4`, session `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`. Checked against GitHub and the diff, not against the report (relayed on the card). The seat opened this PR from the dev's drafts (degraded channel). The body is the dev's draft verbatim; the title adds the card number. The seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` contract review follows this record.

**Checklist**
- **Form:**
  - Draft → `main`, assignee `os-sales`.
  - The first line is `Fixes #12851`, and the second is `Clause-②: yes`, as the claim declares (`6229949012`).
  - Four commits, each carrying only the model-free trailer pair.
  - `git merge-tree` against current `main` is clean. 32 files, +894 / −506. No PNG. Not a governed surface.
  - It also merges cleanly beside objectstack-ai/objectui#12864 (objectui#12848), which edits another row of `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`.
- **Rulings, as bound** (the maintainer's objectstack-ai/cloud#2939 letter A):
  - **The organisation is 「组织」 / Organization / 組織 / Organización:** 21 keys (`workspace.*`, `organizations.*`, and `marketplace.install.noPermission`'s "ask your workspace admin").
  - **The running instance is 「环境」 / Environment:** 14 keys. Setup's subtitle and its `Workspace` category label, the timezone prompt, the tenant sign-in hint, the build refusal, the home loading and empty states, the system-settings quick action, and the cloud home's hints and timezone line.
  - **The cloud home's button reads 「打开」 / Open**, ⛔ not 「打开生产环境」. Both hints say in one line what an environment is.
  - **Keys stay; values change.** No `@object-ui/i18n` key and no component or file name moved. In `en.ts` the only added lines that still say "workspace" are the two unchanged key names (`Workspace:` and `openWorkspace:`).
  - **Two strings kept, each with a reason in the PR:** 「AI 工作区」 (the assistant's work area), and the designer's `appNav.mode.default` (an object's default view, already 工作台 in zh).
  - **Stored names untouched;** no new organisation's default name is composed from a locale string.
  - **Item 5's repo-wide allow-list test is out**, per triage. Pins for the changed strings are in.
- **Mechanism assumptions:** #1 held, though the list missed `marketplace.install.noPermission`; it is fixed here. #2 held. #3 and #4 were falsified, both good results:
  - consumers carry inline `defaultValue` literals that `check:i18n-keys` holds to `en`, and four more consumers read changed keys;
  - `check:i18n-drift` holds VALUES across all ten packs, so a changed `en` value must be followed in every pack.
- **Screenshots, read by the seat** (zh-CN, light; never-merged `claude/issue-12851-evidence` at `5522349`; before on `main` `024d446`, after on this branch):
  - the switcher reads 切换组织 / 创建组织;
  - the avatar menu and the organisations page read 我的组织 / 您的组织;
  - the cloud home reads 打开 and 管理环境, with 「你的环境已就绪——它是运行你的应用的独立实例，有自己的网址、数据库和套餐。」;
  - the home page.

  Sent to the maintainer at 2026-10-17T07:14Z.
- **Tests:**
  - New zh-CN pins with an en CONTROL: the switcher, the avatar menu, the organisations heading, the cloud home's button and hints.
  - The objectui#5215 pack pin is inverted to the ruling across all ten packs. Six existing tests that asserted the old strings changed with them, each named in the PR.
  - One ablation per new pin, each red and each restored.
  - app-shell in full: 14509 tests passed, and `metadata-admin/` again after the last commit. `@object-ui/i18n`: 1325 tests passed.
  - `turbo run build type-check` for i18n, app-shell and console: 39 of 39 tasks passed.
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (35 changed, 315 followed, 0 waived), `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, changeset presence and no-major: all exit 0.
- **Changesets:** `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`, a patch each; user-facing prose.
- **CI:** running at this record. Landing waits for green and for the contract review below.

**Rulings**
1. **`workspace.default` as the home assistant's aria-label ("Open My Organization assistant"): A, as built.** `workspace.*` is the organisation by the ruling. If the maintainer finds that label wrong, it gets its own key on a follow-up card.
2. **The surface supplement: A.** The claim named four packs. Accepted into the surface:
   - the six other packs (ar, de, fr, ko, pt, ru);
   - the four consumers whose inline defaults `check:i18n-keys` forces (`HomeLayout.tsx`, `HomePage.tsx`, `QuickActions.tsx`, the console's `AuthLayout.tsx`);
   - the designer table's `engine.packages.noCapability`.

   All are the same defect class and mechanical. No other claim holds those files, and a drift waiver would have shipped the double meaning in six languages.
3. **`hintReady`'s wording: A, as shipped.** It keeps the ready signal and still defines an environment in one line.
4. **The two out-of-scope notes stay notes:**
   - the backend settings category value `Workspace`, carried by objectstack-ai/objectstack#24142;
   - code identifiers that still say workspace, kept by the keys-stay ruling.

Unblocked once this lands: objectui#12859 (the activity feed's refused-read copy) writes the same packs and waits for this PR.
